title: Chip stocks: $10,000 in AMD vs NVIDIA one year ago
description:
Free market intel: https://www.signumhq.com/app?src=yt_race3

$10,000 into AMD on August 22, 2025. The same $10,000 into NVIDIA.

One year later: AMD is $28,210. NVIDIA is $12,064. Broadcom, over the same year, is $12,532.

Nvidia reports Wednesday, August 26. Going in, it is last of the three.

The road was not smooth for any of them. AMD fell 27.8% at its worst, NVIDIA 20.2%, Broadcom 29.0%.

Split- and dividend-adjusted closes, 251 trading sessions.

#chipstocks #nvidia #amd
